issues: Apart from a 300px 10× and a tiny debug label in the corner the frame was empty, on a dead flat grey-black
The bloom was an even grey-white fog with no film-halation layering and no colour
The subtitle after the hit was 40px grey text, and the number never said what it measured
The last ~3 seconds were completely static with no sense of space (no floor, no light direction)
changes: Midnight look; the hero is now the peak brightness of a fictional display, Vesper XDR: a 330px white-to-ice-blue self-lit 2,000 plus a 96px unit, so the number itself lights the screen when it stops

Four light layers: a tight edge core, a main bloom (6f out-cubic surge to 1.18 then back to 1.03 so it never parks as a ghost copy), an electric-blue outer halation and an anamorphic streak on the stop frame; 20f linear decay decoupled from the spread
Space: Stage top light and horizon band, a glass floor line with the number's reflection (lit up on impact), faint dust, and a one-shot light spill across the dark stage on the stop frame
Layout: a PEAK BRIGHTNESS kicker tracking in between hairlines, a 52px subtitle rising word by word and a 30px mono spec line, all centred on the number's axis
Rhythm: crash zoom 2.7→0.94 at 6–14 with sub-frame motion blur, one visible spring overshoot, followers staggered from 6f later, then a hold with a 2.5% slow push and ±8% bloom breathing; 150f total
